stage0083_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$マコト$$
「Unidentified units have infiltrated the Geofront!」

stage0083_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$冬月$$
「To think something other than an Angel
　would target NERV Headquarters...!」

stage0083_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「I wonder if they've noticed...」

stage0083_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$イズモ$$
「What meaning does this underground city
　hold, $$ミカゲ$$?」

stage0083_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Enough with the joking around.
　With the dimensional boundary stabilizing,
　do you know how much energy a gate costs!」

stage0083_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Don't be so angry, $$イズモ$$.
　The strongest $$レア・イグラー$$'s coming soon」

stage0083_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$アルト$$
「Are you going to be all right, $$アマタ$$!?」

stage0083_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Yeah...!
　If Altair's here, I have to fight!」

stage0083_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Careful, everyone!
　The enemy's supreme commander is here!」

stage0083_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$イズモ$$
（So he's come, the winged boy）

stage0083_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Where have you been, $$カグラ$$!?
　I won't allow you to act on your own!」

stage0083_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Shut up, old man $$イズモ$$!
　That Mechanical Angel's my prey!」

stage0083_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's all right, $$イズモ$$.
　$$カグラ$$ will surely prove useful」

stage0083_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Well then, I'll leave the rest to you」

stage0083_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$イズモ$$
（$$ミカゲ$$, damn him...
　how far will he go with his whims...!）

stage0083_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, prepare to attack!
　We don't know their aim, so stay alert!」

stage0083_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$刹那$$
「I'll... try to find a way
　we can understand each other」

stage0083_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Very well.
　Show me how you fight」

stage0083_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$n
「If $$ガドライト$$'s coming,
　I'll draw him in」

stage0083_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$甲児$$
「But don't forget.
　He's an enemy to all of us」

stage0083_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I understand how you feel,
　but we'll all back you up」

stage0083_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, commence attack!
　Concentrate fire on the enemy commander!」

stage0083_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Here I come, Coward $$アマタ$$!
　I'll kill you and take $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0083_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$カグラ$$!
　I won't let you do as you please!!」

stage0083_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（Why...
　why do the two of them have to fight...）

stage0083_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Unbelievable...!
　To think I would be defeated!」

stage0083_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, restrain the enemy commander...!
　We'll end the war with Altair, here!」

stage0083_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Wait, please!
　A group of units is approaching this area!」

stage0083_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$イズモ$$
「As expected of the force with a
　Mechanical Angel! Strong...!」

stage0083_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, keep targeting the commander...!
　We'll end the war with Altair, here!」

stage0083_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Wait, please!
　A group of units is approaching this area!」

stage0083_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Came back again, Imitation Boy.
　Figured this'd be the spot, after all」

stage0083_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Been a while, Imitation Boy.
　Though it's not you I have business with」

stage0083_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I won't let you have your way...!」

stage0083_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So you showed up, pest!
　Here to watch too?」

stage0083_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Geminis and $$アドヴェント$$...
　Just what's happening here...!?」

stage0083_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$マコト$$
「Intruder confirmed in Central Dogma!!
　Level after level is being breached!!」

stage0083_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$冬月$$
「Why weren't we able to detect
　it until now!?」

stage0083_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Hurry and deal with it」

stage0083_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$マヤ$$
「No good!
　Every countermeasure's being nullified!」

stage0083_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$マコト$$
「Every sensor's being nullified!
　We can't even confirm that much!」

stage0083_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$アンディ$$
「That guy!
　He's come back!」

stage0083_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Too bad, Coward $$アマタ$$!
　If you thought that'd finish me,
　you're dead wrong!」

stage0083_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Coward $$アマタ$$!
　This is where it ends for you!!」

stage0083_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「What the hell is this
　high-dimensional quantum reaction!」

stage0083_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$シュレード$$
「This is from ancient times...!
　A melody resounding down 12,000 years!」

stage0083_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$クレア$$
「There's no mistake!
　That's the legendary Mythical Aquarion!」

stage0083_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Us... are we really witnessing
　such an amazing moment in history...!」

stage0083_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$不動$$
「And now...
　all the truth will be revealed」

stage0083_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Apollo, in a past life,
　was the winged dog Polon...」

stage0083_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$桂$$
「The way he sniffs things...!
　He really was just like a dog!」

stage0083_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$アムロ$$
「The way he was always bounding
　around cheerfully was like a puppy too」

stage0083_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$キラ$$
「Now that you mention it,
　that's true」

stage0083_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$シン$$
「I... always figured he was
　the reincarnation of Apollonius, but...」

stage0083_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$桂$$
「It's common for a pet
　to end up resembling its owner」

stage0083_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
（Also, it's possible someone made
　Apollo carry part of Apollonius's will,
　by design...）

stage0083_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$エマ$$
「That reincarnation of Apollo is...
　$$アマタ$$ and... that Altair warrior...」

stage0083_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That man named $$カグラ$$ certainly
　resembles the Apollo we knew」

stage0083_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「So he's the one with Apollo's
　wildness and aggression extracted?」

stage0083_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$カグラ$$
「That's kind of interesting, isn't it!!」

stage0083_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Good chance, Coward $$アマタ$$!
　Let's settle here which of us is
　$$アポロン$$'s reincarnation, bound to $$シルフィ$$!!」

stage0083_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「If that's how you want it!!」

stage0083_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I don't want to watch the two of
　you hurt each other anymore!」

stage0083_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「No, $$ミコノ$$! Today, we're
　settling this for good!」

stage0083_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Pretty good resolve,
　for Coward $$アマタ$$!」

stage0083_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Is it just fate that makes you
　want $$ミコノ$$!」

stage0083_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$カグラ$$
「That's right,
　don't make me say it again!」

stage0083_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm not like that!
　Whether $$ミコノ$$'s $$シルフィ$$'s reincarnation,
　or fate from 12,000 years back, means nothing!」

stage0083_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm... the here and now...
　the $$ミコノ$$ here and now that I...!」

stage0083_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$アマタ$$
「It's this $$ミコノ$$, right now,
　right this instant, that I...aaah!!」

stage0083_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「You said your name was $$カグラ$$.
　Let me tell you one thing」

stage0083_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「You certainly resemble
　the Apollo we knew. But that's
　only one side of him」

stage0083_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$桂$$
「At a glance he seemed rough
　and savage, but he was truly kind,
　and never cared whose reincarnation he was」

stage0083_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's probably why a man like that
　overcame his past life, his fate,
　and won Sylvia's heart」

stage0083_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Me...!
　You're saying I'm losing
　to Coward $$アマタ$$!?」

stage0083_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Aren't you, who feared Aquarion's
　power, the one who understands
　that best?」

stage0083_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$カグラ$$
「That's the Mechanical Angel's power!
　Not Coward $$アマタ$$'s power!!」

stage0083_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$アマタ$$
「What are you planning, $$カグラ$$!」

stage0083_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$カグラ$$
「The fight's on hold, Coward $$アマタ$$!
　Next time we meet, this Mechanical
　Angel takes you down!!」

stage0083_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$イズモ$$
「$$カグラ$$, curse you!
　I won't let you have the true Mechanical Angel!!」

stage0083_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
???
「Lord $$イズモ$$, leave the rest to me」

stage0083_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「12,000 years... 24,000 years...
　no, a toast to 120,000,000 years of this farce!」

stage0083_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But now, the wedge driven into the earth is out!
　The balance between the two worlds crumbles!」

stage0083_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「If you think someone's just gonna explain
　everything to you, you're dead wrong, kid」

stage0083_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Like that beast of a boy earlier,
　you take what you want by force, huh!」

stage0083_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Then that's exactly what I'll do!」

stage0083_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Let's do this, $n...!
　We'll seize the future with our own hands!」

stage0083_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「All units, stay alert!
　The Geminis are ignoring the Altair forces
　and coming straight for us!」

stage0083_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「How plucky, pest.
　Coming at me again, undaunted?」

stage0083_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I told you already, $$ガドライト$$.
　$n is my hope...」

stage0083_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「It's about time you realized:
　you're not the only one who can wield Taiji's power!」

stage0083_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$n
「Here I come, $$ガドライト$$!
　I'll beat you and shatter the Prison of Time!」

stage0083_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$n
「Don't think you can keep that smug grin
　on your face forever!!」

stage0083_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「All units, stay alert!
　The Geminis are ignoring the Altair forces
　and coming straight for us!」

stage0083_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「How plucky, pest.
　Why go so far to help these guys?」

stage0083_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I'll say it once, $$ガドライト$$.
　$n is my hope」

stage0083_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「It's about time you realized:
　you're not the only one who can wield Taiji's power!」

stage0083_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$n
「Here I come, $$ガドライト$$!
　I'll beat you and shatter the Prison of Time!」

stage0083_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$n
「Don't think you can keep that smug grin
　on your face forever!!」

stage0083_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
???
「Tch!
　You've got some nerve, warrior from Vega!」

stage0083_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Same as ever, all mouth and no substance!」

stage0083_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Not bad at all...
　Guess I'll have to get a little serious myself」

stage0083_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「What an annoying bunch...
　Guess I'll have to get a little serious myself」

stage0083_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Not here, of all places...!」

stage0083_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't push yourself, $$アンナロッタ$$.
　Fall back」

stage0083_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「No...!
　I can still fight!」

stage0083_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I'll be fine.
　I'm getting a little serious from here」

stage0083_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$シモン$$
「Sure, he's strong...!
　But we've gotten stronger too!」

stage0083_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Sorry to get your hopes up,
　but I haven't shown my hand yet」

stage0083_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Forgotten already?
　How I sowed the spark of war」

stage0083_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$甲児$$
「You're trying to amplify our hidden feelings!?」

stage0083_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$赤木$$
「Too bad for you!
　It's already proven that doesn't work
　in Paradigm City!」

stage0083_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Why is it you all go around thinking
　you're something special!?」

stage0083_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Only you never yield to despair,
　only you grow strong, only you pull off
　the comeback win... You think it works that way?」

stage0083_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Everyone, keep your hearts strong!
　He's growing the power of his $$スフィア$$!」

stage0083_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Too slow!
　This is the power of a $$スフィア・リアクター$$
　that's reached the Third Stage!!」

stage0083_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$キラ$$
「My will to fight... it's fading away...」

stage0083_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「This weak heart I thought I'd long since
　thrown away... it's spreading through me...」

stage0083_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I-I'm scared...
　Help me... help me...」

stage0083_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「At this rate...!
　We'll be crushed by the weakness in each of our hearts!」

stage0083_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「If everyone unites their hearts as one,
　we may be able to break through this weakness!」

stage0083_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Wait, $$刹那$$!
　The $$ダブルオーライザー$$ as it is now...!」

stage0083_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You think that little bit is enough
　to break my squabbling twins!?」

stage0083_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「No good!
　The unit can't take any more!」

stage0083_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「The $$ダブルオーライザー$$ right now is running
　on stored GN particles!
　This is the limit!!」

stage0083_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Damn it...! Damn it all!」

stage0083_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「The hell is this...
　My will to fight just keeps draining away...」

stage0083_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's right, just like that.
　Quit resisting, and sleep in the stillness of time」

stage0083_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$グラハム$$
（Why... was I trying to fight...）

stage0083_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$宗介$$
（Chidori... In a world without war,
　with you...）

stage0083_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$キリコ$$
（$$フィアナ$$... I'll go into eternity too...）

stage0083_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
（So this is... the paradise God ordained...）

stage0083_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Decaying within frozen time...
　Perhaps that's fine too...」

stage0083_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I... won't accept something like that!」

stage0083_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That guy...!
　What nerve, activating the Zero System
　in a situation like this!」

stage0083_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$五飛$$
「But that...!
　That'll be the power to break his $$スフィア$$!」

stage0083_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「What are you thinking, kid?」

stage0083_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I... deny the world you're trying to create...!」

stage0083_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「A world where time has stopped...
　a world with no future...
　$$リリーナ$$ doesn't wish for that!」

stage0083_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I see.
　So you deny frozen time by picturing the future」

stage0083_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Admirable, kid...!
　But there's a limit to what one person can do!」

stage0083_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$フェルト$$
「A unit resembling a transport plane
　is closing in from above!」

stage0083_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ミレイナ$$
「This is...!
　It's Dad's $$シャトル$$!」

stage0083_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$イアン$$
「This is $$イアン・ヴァスティ$$ of Celestial Being!
　Launching the Qan[T] now!」

stage0083_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「You made it in time!」

stage0083_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Its name is the $$ダブルオークアンタ$$!」

stage0083_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$刹那$$! Switch to the Qan[T]!」

stage0083_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Quantum Burst...
　The Qan[T]'s ultimate power」

stage0083_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Even though it's not fully complete yet,
　to think it could do this much...」

stage0083_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$ヒイロ$$ and $$刹那$$'s strong resolve...
　It's flowing into my heart...!」

stage0083_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$n
「It's not just the two of them...!
　I can feel everyone in $c!」

stage0083_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n's eyes are back to normal!」

stage0083_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$イアン$$
「The Qan[T] is a machine built exclusively
　for $$刹那$$, awakened as an Innovator.
　Unfinished, but it outclasses the $$ダブルオーライザー$$ entirely!」

stage0083_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Everyone's hearts are becoming one...
　Just like back then... no, even stronger...!」

stage0083_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Tch!
　You're saying it's a match for my $$スフィア$$!?」

stage0083_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「But if this standoff keeps up,
　he'll eventually be overtaken by $$ガドライト$$...!」

stage0083_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$アルト$$
「If we stop him before that...!」

stage0083_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Basically, I just gotta burn my soul hotter, right!」

stage0083_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's do this, $$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$!」

stage0083_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$カレン$$
「It's $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$'s 'Lion'!!」

stage0083_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$アルト$$
「Riding the GN particles, $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$'s
　feelings... $$バサラ$$'s soul is spreading out!」

stage0083_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$オズマ$$
「$$アルト$$! Activate the Fold Wave System!」

stage0083_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ルカ$$
「The YF-29 is equipped with
　ultra-high-purity Fold Quartz!
　It's sure to amplify everyone's feelings!」

stage0083_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$!
　I'll fly with everything I've got too!!」

stage0083_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「No way!
　You pushed back the power of my $$スフィア$$!?」

stage0083_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「No way...!
　The $$ジェミニア$$ being broken through...!」

stage0083_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't screw with me!
　I'm a Third-Stage $$スフィア・リアクター$$!!」

stage0083_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$不動$$
「Element Change!
　$$ゲパルト$$, $$アンディ・Ｗ・ホール$$!」

stage0083_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$不動$$
「Element Change!
　$$スパーダ$$, $$シュレード・エラン$$!」

stage0083_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Let me add my melody
　to this heart-stirring unison.」

stage0083_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I'm on fire!
　Nobody can stop me now!!」

stage0083_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
???
「You Mechanical Angel!
　Don't get carried away!」

stage0083_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Their mind is flowing into me!」

stage0083_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Take your lovers' quarrel elsewhere!」

stage0083_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Don't get in my way!!」

stage0083_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「W-what is this intensity...!」

stage0083_04:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Don't worry about me, $$アンディ$$!
　Now's the time to let your feelings ring out!」

stage0083_04:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Got it, $$シュレード$$!
　Lend me your strength!」

stage0083_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$アンディ$$
「$$ＭＩＸ$$...!
　No matter what body you end up with,
　I'll come for you, I swear!」

stage0083_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I told you before, $$ＭＩＸ$$...!
　Holes... holes are for connecting worlds!」

stage0083_04:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I'll punch a huge hole in your heart too!
　A huge hole to bury myself in!」

stage0083_04:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$シュレード$$
「$$アンディ$$, leave the rest to me!」

stage0083_04:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Sorry, but I don't have much time left...!
　Let me play you the fastest toccata there is!」

stage0083_04:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Get back, $$アンナロッタ$$!
　You can't die on me!」

stage0083_04:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$スズネ$$
（That person named $$ガドライト$$...）

stage0083_04:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$キラ$$
「Yeah, this is how Aquarion should be.」

stage0083_04:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$桂$$
「Turning the tables with absurd power's
　been tradition for twelve thousand years!」

stage0083_04:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$アンディ$$, $$シュレード$$...」

stage0083_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$シュレード$$
「We move forward...!
　For what we believe in, for what we love!」

stage0083_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$甲児$$
「All that's left is to beat $$ガドライト$$!」

stage0083_04:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...man, this is getting old...
　Ganging up to break through my $$スフィア$$...
　It's enough to make a guy lose confidence.」

stage0083_04:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's your limit.
　Give up, $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$.」

stage0083_04:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Give up...?
　I did that a long, long time ago...」

stage0083_04:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「But still...!
　That's just not gonna cut it!」

stage0083_04:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「What are you talking about.
　Don't get cocky just 'cause you scored one hit.」

stage0083_04:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Fighting head-on, me and the $$ジェミニア$$
　wouldn't lose to the likes of you.」

stage0083_04:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Here I come, $c...!
　Once you're wishing you'd stayed asleep,
　it'll be too late to regret it!!」

stage0083_04:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$刹那$$
「We... won't give up on the future!」

stage0083_04:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Target for attack... $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$!」

stage0083_04:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Tch... just not feeling it today.」

stage0083_04:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Yeah, yeah, that's right.
　There's no way I could actually fight
　you guys head-on and win.」

stage0083_04:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So that's why I'll be laying low.
　Until November 11th, as this planet calls it.」

stage0083_04:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$タケル$$
「The day the $$エタニティ・フラット$$ is complete!」

stage0083_04:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「See ya, $c!
　Next time, let's meet within frozen time!」

stage0083_04:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So the Altair forces retreated too...」

stage0083_04:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$アンディ$$
「No time to mope.
　At least I know $$ＭＩＸ$$'s safe.」

stage0083_04:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Even if $$ＭＩＸ$$'s become a man,
　I'll save them, no matter what!」

stage0083_04:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Shall I tell you why she became a man?」

stage0083_04:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$アルト$$!
　The one he's got with him is...!」

stage0083_04:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Eve's curse, cast upon Altair...
　That's exactly why we seek a $$レア・イグラー$$,
　and why that girl became a boy...」

stage0083_04:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Eve's curse didn't stop at erasing
　every $$イグラー$$ from Altair...」

stage0083_04:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The $$イグラー$$s brought here from Vega
　were touched by that same curse, too,
　and had their sex transformed.」

stage0083_04:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$アンディ$$
「You mean she became a man!?」

stage0083_04:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But there are a rare few $$イグラー$$s strong enough
　to throw off that curse entirely...
　Yes... those are the $$レア・イグラー$$s.」

stage0083_04:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And the strongest $$レア・イグラー$$ among them
　becomes the true Eve, and saves Altair.」

stage0083_04:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And that's these two...
　Divas overflowing with life,
　whose voices even cross dimensions.」

stage0083_04:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$アルト$$
「You mean to take $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$
　to Altair!?」

stage0083_04:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Now that I've obtained the true Mechanical Angel,
　I've no more interest in Vega.
　I'll watch its ruin from Altair from here on.」

stage0083_04:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$カイエン$$
「To have the Mythical Aquarion taken,
　and lose the two whose power breaks
　the Prison of Time...」

stage0083_04:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
???
「Damn it!
　Fall back once and regroup!」

stage0083_04:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Beat it and don't come back!
　You cocky little punk!」

stage0083_04:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「What's wrong, $$アンディ$$?
　You seem oddly hard on them...」

stage0083_04:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Even I don't really get it, but
　seeing them just gets to me somehow...」

stage0083_04:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Damn, an unwanted interruption!
　Guess I'll fall back and wait for a chance!」

stage0083_04:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$カイエン$$
「That was a pretty easy retreat for him.」

stage0083_04:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「He'll definitely come back.
　To settle things with me, and to make $$ミコノ$$ his.」

stage0083_04:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$アマタ$$
「If we defeat him, Altair's Supreme Commander,
　the fighting will end!」

stage0083_04:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$イズモ$$
（So, this boy really is my...）

stage0083_04:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$イズモ$$
（But for now, I set aside personal feelings...!
　I will fulfill my duty as Altair's
　Supreme Commander!）

stage0083_04:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I'll settle this once and for all,
　you coward $$アマタ$$!」

stage0083_04:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Just what I wanted, $$カグラ$$!」

stage0083_04:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「There's no way you can beat me!
　Not you, who gave up that day!」

stage0083_04:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm not who I was back then!
　I'll never let anyone take someone
　precious to me again!!」

stage0083_04:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（Why... why do they have to fight...）

stage0083_04:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
???
「You Mechanical Angel!
　If you're going to get in our way,
　I'll be your opponent myself!」

stage0083_04:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Don't think the likes of you can
　be a match for Aquarion!」

stage0083_04:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
???
「It's you who I'll be testing,
　to see if you can handle me!」

stage0083_04:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Always got a comeback, huh...!
　What a cocky bastard!」

stage0083_04:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「$F!
　There's no need to trouble the captain!
　I'll be the one to take you down!」

stage0083_04:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$n
「Get out of the way, $$アンナロッタ$$!
　My target is $$ガドライト$$!」

stage0083_04:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「I won't let you...!
　Protecting him is my final duty!」

stage0083_04:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$n
「$$ガドライト$$!
　Today, I'll finally take you down!」

stage0083_04:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Persistent, aren't you, kid.
　I don't know how much you hate me,
　but don't you think revenge is a hassle?」

stage0083_04:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Getting revenge won't bring anything back
　anyway. So wouldn't you rather try
　living more positively?」

stage0083_04:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$n
「...I've thought that myself,
　more times than you'd have to tell me...」

stage0083_04:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$n
「But still!
　That's not enough for me to move on!
　I still see my dad and sister's faces from that day!」

stage0083_04:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$n
「That's why I'm going to defeat you!
　I'll think about what comes next after that!!」

stage0083_04:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$ガドライト$$
（I see...
　What $$アンナロッタ$$ meant about him
　and me being alike... it's finally clicking.）

stage0083_04:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$刹那$$
「Quanta...
　Your true purpose lies beyond battle...」

stage0083_04:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$刹那$$
「But for now, I fight...!
　To end the fighting in this world!」

stage0083_04:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$アルト$$
（Why I fly... why I fight...!
　It's to protect them!）

stage0083_04:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$$アルト$$
（I'll protect them!
　This world, $$シェリル$$, and $$ランカ$$ too!）

stage0083_04:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well, this is a surprise!
　Pretty slick, huh!」

stage0083_04:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「If the world was full of folks like you,
　it'd be a total blast!」

stage0083_04:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Hahaha, you're just like honey!
　That angry face is cute too!」
